dict.string: MotoMap uses Bluetooth to send turn instructions to the ESP32 display.
MotoMap uses Bluetooth to connect to the ESP32 display.
MotoMap uses your location to calculate and update motorcycle navigation.
MotoMap uses your location during an active navigation session, including when the screen is locked.
MotoMap connects to the local MotoMap ESP32 Wi-Fi network to send media frames.
MotoMap lets you choose photos and videos to display on the ESP32.
